rows.definition: The Session admission check for the deepseek_v4 Flash attention schedule. It returns the existing typed refusal for an invalid compression ratio or an unimplemented ratio 4/128 layer. GenerateContext returns this error; nonempty Prefill and PrefillNoLogits calls and every Step call panic with it before forward state or keepalive begins.
rows.distinction: This is an architecture admission check, not an attention computation or backend-operation failure. It leaves ratio-zero schedules, absent schedules and other model families admitted, including the distinct deepseek_v41 path. The served recovery seam recognizes only its two declared sentinel errors. Unlike the sliding_attention layer-type selector, this check refuses a model schedule and executes no attention.
